answer: A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the forge ordering is published with the atlas batch, the shale audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 57% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 126 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
